verdict.rationale: CRA's own EFILE channel lets enrolled electronic filers transmit many clients' returns, current and up to seven prior years, system-to-system from certified software, with transmission history visible. That is the closest documented form of multi-item operations, but the evidence never describes true batch or bulk submission in a single action. BRO's ability to register several program accounts on one form is a single-entity convenience rather than a bulk operation across many items. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk submission or update capability, documented limits or volumes per transmission, bulk operations beyond return filing (e.g., payments, account changes), any independent or hands-on corroboration.
